title.ja: 独自逆モードVJPとJVP/VJP双対性
title.en: Original reverse-mode VJP and JVP/VJP duality

summary.ja: 重複gatherとbroadcastを含む真の逆tapeを独立Jacobianと照合します。
summary.en: Check a genuine reverse tape, including repeated-index gather and broadcast, against independent Jacobians.

assumptions.ja: 小さな固定入力・実数・無次元。詳しい入力と適用範囲は対応する契約に限定します。
assumptions.en: Small fixed real dimensionless inputs; assumptions and scope are limited to the matching contract.

algorithm.ja: 逆topological順のcotangent加算と独立の前向き方向計算です。
algorithm.en: Accumulate cotangents in reverse topological order with a separate forward directional path.

validation.ja: 固定入力・独立参照・保存候補・全判定を同じ120秒予算内で検証します。数値合格と診断用非収束を区別します。
validation.en: Check fixed inputs, independent references, retained candidates and every gate within the same120-second budget. Numerical success and diagnostic nonconvergence are distinct.

limits.ja: 一般のNumPy/JAX置換や複素数ADではありません。
limits.en: Not a general NumPy/JAX replacement or complex AD system.

caption.ja: 独立矩形Jacobianと実際の逆微分誤差、固定wide写像の実測sweep数。
caption.en: Independent rectangular Jacobian, actual reverse differentiation error and measured sweep counts for fixed wide maps.

title.ja: HVPと状態固定・陰関数全微分の区別
title.en: Hessian-vector products and fixed-state versus implicit derivatives

summary.ja: forward-over-reverse HVPと二階陰関数則を別々の独立参照へ照合します。
summary.en: Check forward-over-reverse HVPs and second-order implicit rules against separate independent references.

assumptions.ja: 小さな固定入力・実数・無次元。詳しい入力と適用範囲は対応する契約に限定します。
assumptions.en: Small fixed real dimensionless inputs; assumptions and scope are limited to the matching contract.

algorithm.ja: 値と方向接線、cotangentとその方向接線を伝播し、陰関数はF/R1/R2を解きます。
algorithm.en: Transport values, tangents, cotangents and cotangent tangents; solve F/R1/R2 for implicit derivatives.

validation.ja: 固定入力・独立参照・保存候補・全判定を同じ120秒予算内で検証します。数値合格と診断用非収束を区別します。
validation.en: Check fixed inputs, independent references, retained candidates and every gate within the same120-second budget. Numerical success and diagnostic nonconvergence are distinct.

limits.ja: 一般のreduced inverse Hessianや有限Newton traceの数学的陰関数微分とは主張しません。
limits.en: No general reduced inverse Hessian or identification of finite Newton traces with implicit derivatives.

caption.ja: 保存HVPと独立参照、状態固定と陰関数全微分の二階曲率を区別した比較。
caption.en: Saved HVPs and independent references, with fixed-state and total implicit second derivatives shown separately.

title.ja: 非滑らか点・分岐・停止条件の微分範囲
title.en: Derivative scope at kinks, branches and stopping decisions

summary.ja: 古典微分・一方向微分・実行trace微分を、kinkと停止分岐の固定例で区別します。
summary.en: Distinguish classical, one-sided directional and executed-trace derivatives at fixed kinks and stopping switches.

assumptions.ja: 小さな固定入力・実数・無次元。詳しい入力と適用範囲は対応する契約に限定します。
assumptions.en: Small fixed real dimensionless inputs; assumptions and scope are limited to the matching contract.

algorithm.ja: strict nondifferentiableを明示し、停止前<=判定の実行分岐だけを記録します。
algorithm.en: Report strict nondifferentiability explicitly and record the literal top-of-loop stopping branch.

validation.ja: 固定入力・独立参照・保存候補・全判定を同じ120秒予算内で検証します。数値合格と診断用非収束を区別します。
validation.en: Check fixed inputs, independent references, retained candidates and every gate within the same120-second budget. Numerical success and diagnostic nonconvergence are distinct.

limits.ja: 選択した分岐の微分は普遍的なsubgradientや非滑らかな写像の線形微分ではありません。
limits.en: An executed-branch derivative is not a universal subgradient or a linear derivative of a nonsmooth map.

caption.ja: 保存した非滑らか関数値と停止写像、古典微分が未定義な点とtrace微分を分けた表示。
caption.en: Saved nonsmooth values and stopped-map samples, distinguishing undefined classical derivatives from trace derivatives.
